report_title: Operational Decision Support & Strategic Inquiries Report

inquiries.operational_question: Is additional OCR worker infrastructure provisioning required for upcoming quarter?
evidence_telemetry: OCR worker utilization averaged 50% over last 30 days.
90-day capacity forecast predicts max peak utilization of 72%.
P95 OCR queue dwell time remains under 45ms.
inquiries.recommended_decision: Maintain current worker provisioning; defer hardware expansion to next budget cycle.
inquiries.projected_impact: Avoid $12,000 in premature cloud compute spend while sustaining < 50ms queue dwell times.

inquiries.operational_question: Are the current 99.9% availability and 500ms P95 latency SLO targets sustainable under projected traffic growth?
evidence_telemetry: Measured availability over rolling 30 days is 99.98% (target: 99.90%).
Remaining 30-day error budget is 83.2% with 0.45x burn rate.
inquiries.recommended_decision: Sustain existing SLO targets; tighten internal SLO alert threshold to 99.95% without customer SLA change.
inquiries.projected_impact: Provides early operational buffer for engineering teams during major feature rollouts.

inquiries.operational_question: Is Gemini AI provider degradation occurring or is document complexity increasing?
evidence_telemetry: Raw API endpoint round-trip latency to Gemini is stable at 1950ms (+/- 3%).
Average token count per document increased by 14% due to new multi-page contract onboarding.
JSON schema extraction adherence remains rock-solid at 99.6%.
inquiries.recommended_decision: AI provider is fully healthy; document payload size increase is normal business expansion.
inquiries.projected_impact: Direct engineering focus to document chunking optimizations rather than vendor escalation.
